conf.description: PKI CA + OCSP (CAC/PIV) ocsp-access / syslog-raw: thin pass-through, parsing deferred to Elastic (elastic-ingest-pipeline).

conf.comment: pki-ocsp / ocsp-access / syslog-raw. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic ingest pipeline decodes this downstream (logs-iis.access@custom (Common Log Format grok, reusing the Apache/NGINX common-log grammar)). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).

functions.description: record why this pipeline does not parse
tag the dataset before Elastic parses _raw
